content.short: StakeStone is an omnichain liquid staking protocol that provides highly liquid, yield-bearing assets via STONE.
content.description:
StakeStone is a leading omnichain liquid staking protocol designed to provide users with a highly liquid and composable yield-bearing asset, STONE. Built on LayerZero technology, STONE is an Omnichain Fungible Token (OFT) that can be seamlessly bridged across multiple networks—including Mantle, Linea, and Scroll—without losing its yield-accruing properties. The protocol optimizes returns by dynamically allocating staked ETH into a diversified selection of blue-chip liquid staking derivatives and restaking strategies on EigenLayer.

Designed for maximum capital efficiency, StakeStone serves as a vital liquidity hub for the decentralized economy, allowing participants to earn multiple layers of yield while maintaining total control over their assets. The platform focuses on professional-grade risk management and transparent on-chain execution, making it a cornerstone of the cross-chain DeFi landscape. Through its commitment to simplified decentralized staking and high-performance financial tools, StakeStone is empowering participants to build more robust and Interconnected decentralized portfolios with ease.
